summary: Tests if sparse autoencoders find the true features of synthetic data, where the answer is known.
description:
Trains sparse autoencoders (SAEs) on synthetic activations with known features, then compares each SAE with the true features. The data has realistic traits: correlation, hierarchy, superposition and Zipf-like firing rates. The data is not from a real model, so its results never add to the SAEBench results.

Each design trains with some seeds, and the tables show the mean over the seeds with its standard error.

links.title: SynthSAEBench: Evaluating Sparse Autoencoders on Scalable Realistic Synthetic Data
